correctness.rationale: The conjugate map has exactly two full inverse branches on [1/3,1]. Its normalized density dz/(z log 3) satisfies an algebraically verified transfer balance. Each binary cylinder equals a projective-Möbius image of [1/3,1] and therefore has the stated exact cross-ratio mass. The fixed positive endpoint matrix Q interwines both branch matrices with transpose, which proves arbitrary-length word reversal. Exact all-zero cylinders and a strict derivative calculation exclude every finite Markov order. A standalone exact-integer/rational checker verified 4094 words and additional endpoint/transfer identities; this finite replay is corroboration, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The precise map has a non-invertible interval action but a stationary binary observation that is fully time-reversal symmetric in every dimension and nevertheless has unbounded conditional memory. An exact closed form for all finite-word masses gives a substantial dynamical-statistical structural classification beyond one-point invariant density or any arbitrary finite observation. The result is meaningful without a broader family theorem.
